connectors.itad.name: IsThereAnyDeal
connectors.itad.intro.title: Connect IsThereAnyDeal
connectors.itad.intro.body:
IsThereAnyDeal is a price comparison service. Connecting it is optional: without it, Ludiary simply does not show prices. Ludiary is not affiliated with IsThereAnyDeal.
What is sent to IsThereAnyDeal: the identifiers of your Steam and GOG games and the titles of the games whose price you look at, the titles you search for and your country. These requests are linked to your IsThereAnyDeal account through your key.
The links of the offers go through IsThereAnyDeal, which sees the click before you reach the store.
You need a free IsThereAnyDeal account.
connectors.itad.apikey.title: Create your IsThereAnyDeal key
connectors.itad.apikey.body:
The key is a free code that lets Ludiary ask for prices in your name.
Press “Open the page”: IsThereAnyDeal opens in a new tab. Create an account if you do not have one, and verify your email (without it, the limit of requests is lower).
Register an application, for example “Ludiary personal”.
Copy the “API key” (not the “Client ID” or the OAuth secret).
Come back to this tab and press “Paste”.
connectors.itad.errors.format: That key does not look right. It must be 16 to 128 letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores, with no spaces.
connectors.itad.errors.invalid: IsThereAnyDeal does not accept the key. Check that you copied the “API key” whole and that it has not been deleted, then connect again.
connectors.itad.errors.rateLimited: IsThereAnyDeal asks you to wait before the next request. Try again in a few minutes.
connectors.itad.errors.unavailable: IsThereAnyDeal is not responding right now. Try again later.
connectors.itad.errors.unexpected: IsThereAnyDeal sent an answer Ludiary does not understand. It may have changed; try again later.
